array_interpretation: finite-volume cell averages; q[x,y,variable]; solid dummy values are not part of the fluid solution
solid: x>=0.6 and y<0.2; all fixed grids align exactly
left_boundary: fixed uniform Mach3 inflow on the complete entrance
right_boundary: zero-gradient primitive outflow on open fluid faces
walls: slip reflection at y=0 upstream of step, y=1, step riser x=.6 below y=.2, step top y=.2 downstream of x=.6
method: independent standalone C++17 primitive-MUSCL generalized minmod(theta=1.5), Davis HLL and Heun/SSPRK(2,2)
slopes: directional primitive slopes vanish if either normal neighbor is outside fluid; per-direction positivity slope rescaling leaves conserved cell average unchanged
stage_checks: all fluid rho,p finite and >0 at both updated RK stages; raw failed stage is written and process fails
conservation: Heun-weighted fluxes on outer boundaries and both solid step faces, including wall momentum tractions
comparison: conservatively restrict q, then compute pressure; exclude identically aligned solid cells
scope: Same uncorrected-corner variant as primary. Numerical entropy generated at corner can pollute downstream flow; not exact 2D solution, original corner-corrected PPM reproduction, or proof of full-pattern convergence.
